description: "Tractus de Hermaphrodites; Or, A Treatise of Hermaphrodites" by Giles Jacob is a scientific publication written in the early 18th century. This book provides a comprehensive exploration of the phenomenon of hermaphrodites, which are individuals possessing both male and female reproductive organs.
